name: com.uni-tx.daily-rewards
description: Daily login reward calendars as entities: a configurable UTC reset hour, calendar and streak modes, looped or finite calendars, one idempotent claim per day, and failed deliveries queued for retry.

samples.description: A seven-day looping calendar walked through a manual clock: claiming day by day, skipping a missed day, and watching the streak break and recover.

A uGUI calendar screen: header with streak and countdown, day cells with reward icons and a milestone badge, and a claim button that only appears on today's slot. Needs com.uni-tx.widgets and com.uni-tx.sprite-loader; without them the sample's assembly is skipped rather than breaking the project.
